# its H observation, the H expected class that the current source produces, the fix that changes it, and the
# direction.  A row is POST-HOC because the H observations were recorded in S2R3 before this map existed; the
# map is written AFTER them.  Rows are INFLUENCED.

#   which are structural (H has no family-B point) and are declared as such by user decision D-U1.
